The 'Source [S1] notes' section states that the method 'uses an occupancy grid to skip empty space during coarse sampling' (which corresponds to 'guided by spatial occupancy') and 'uses hierarchical sampling to refine sample positions based on coarse weights' (which corresponds to 'guided by rendered weights'). The code snippets further confirm that the coarse sampling phase checks for an `occupancy_grid` to sample occupied regions, and the fine sampling phase calls `sample_hierarchical` using `weights_coarse`. This decoupling allows the system to avoid re-evaluating empty space during the fine stage, supporting the claim of efficient refinement.
